intro.text: The captain of the ship First Dreams.

items.text: Obsessed with tales of riches on the island of Akinah, Vazrmeb and his helmsman Droz set out to reach it. He hired a mercenary crew in Steen and, at great expense, the Soulcaster Kaza in Liafor to turn the island's stone spikes to smoke.

The ship sailed north through a deadly storm that ended suddenly near Akinah, and Kaza Soulcast the spikes. But the ship's cook, a Sleepless posing as a human, had poisoned Vazrmeb and the rest of the crew.
When the First Dreams reappeared as a ghost ship, Navani Kholin learned of Vazrmeb's ambition from the prince of Liafor, without learning his fate.

appearance.text: A Thaylen with long white eyebrows and long curly hair, as tall as an Alethi, with large arms and hands.

personality.text: Boisterous and far from the stereotypical thrifty Thaylen merchant; a capable captain who kept his crew in order through a deadly storm.
